Progress Software Corp (NASDAQ:PRGS) institutional sentiment increased to 0.94 in Q3 2018 . Its up 0.13, from 0.81 in 2018Q2. The ratio is more positive, as 93 active investment managers opened new or increased positions, while 99 sold and decreased their stakes in Progress Software Corp. The active investment managers in our partner’s database now possess: 39.64 million shares, up from 39.53 million shares in 2018Q2. Also, the number of active investment managers holding Progress Software Corp in their top 10 positions was flat from 1 to 1 for the same number . Sold All: 18 Reduced: 81 Increased: 66 New Position: 27.
Progress Software Corporation provides software solutions for various industries worldwide. The company has market cap of $1.63 billion. The Company’s OpenEdge segment offers Progress OpenEdge, a development software, which manufactures multi-language applications for secure deployment across various platforms and devices, as well as cloud; and Progress Corticon, a business rules management system that enables applications with decision automation and change process, and decision-related insight capabilities. It has a 27.61 P/E ratio. The companyÂ’s Data Connectivity and Integration segment provides Progress DataDirect Connect software, which offers data connectivity using industry-standard interfaces to connect applications running on various platforms; and Progress DataDirect Cloud, a software-as-a-service based connection management service that simplifies SQL access to a spectrum of cloud data sources through a single standards interface.
The stock decreased 0.82% or $0.3 during the last trading session, reaching $36.23. About 386,845 shares traded or 11.60% up from the average. Progress Software Corporation (NASDAQ:PRGS) has declined 16.18% since January 17, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 16.18% the S&P500.
